subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should trusted hooks receive blocked Telegram and WhatsApp DM content before admission, and may an installed trusted access-request hook auto-activate solely from existing `dmPolicy: "allowlist"` configuration?
rationale: This changes both the pre-authentication privacy boundary and runtime activation behavior for existing installations; code correctness cannot determine the intended product security policy.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a dedicated pre-auth hook enable setting, default it off, and expose only the minimum approved metadata or content after deliberate operator activation.

options.title: Accept trusted auto-load
options.body: Treat allowlist DM policy as consent for trusted pre-auth hooks and document blocked-message exposure as a stable core security contract.

options.title: Pause content hooks
options.body: Limit the design to a narrower metadata-only pairing or security event until maintainers sponsor blocked-message content exposure.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a dedicated pre-auth hook enable setting, default it off, and expose only the minimum approved metadata or content after deliberate operator activation.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest history signal is the canonical access-groups implementation and its adjacent channel authorization and configuration surfaces.
